lines.text: Many learners say: He explained me the rule.
Better: He explained the rule to me.
With explain, say to before the person.
Explain! Please explain it to me.

data.right: He explained the rule to me.
data.why: With explain, say to before the person.

native.tip: explain 后面先说事情，再用 “to + 人”。

en.tip: After explain, say the thing first, then “to” the person.
en.caption: Do you say “He explained me the rule.”? 😅 After explain, name the thing first, then use to for the person: “He explained the rule to me.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
